get.description:
<Note>To use our EU server for LLM Gateway, replace `llm-gateway.assemblyai.com` with `llm-gateway.eu.assemblyai.com`.</Note>

Returns the list of models available through LLM Gateway, including the supported parameters, context length, pricing, and regional availability of each model. This endpoint doesn't require authentication.

200.description: Successful response containing the list of available models.

LLMGatewayRequest.description: The main request body for the chat completions endpoint.

messages.description: A list of messages comprising the conversation so far.

prompt.description: A simple string prompt. The API will automatically convert this into a user message.

transcript_id.description: Optional. The ID of an AssemblyAI transcript whose text replaces the first `{{ transcript }}` tag in the prompt. See [Inject a transcript by ID](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/llm-gateway/chat-completions#inject-a-transcript-by-id) for substitution rules and edge cases.

model.description: The ID of the model to use for this request. See [LLM Gateway Overview](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/llm-gateway/quickstart#available-models) for available models.

model_region.description: Optional. Routes the request to the provider's global (non-region) endpoints for lower-cost processing. The only accepted value is `global`; omit this field for default in-region processing. Currently live for Anthropic Claude models, with Google Gemini 3 series coming soon.

max_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the completion. Default is 1000.

temperature.description: Controls randomness. Lower values produce more deterministic results.

stream.description: When true, responses are streamed as server-sent events (SSE). Supported on OpenAI models only.

tools.description: A list of tools the model may call.

response_format.description: Specifies the format of the model's response. Use this to constrain the model to output valid JSON matching a schema. Supported by OpenAI (GPT-4.1, GPT-5.x), Gemini, and Claude models. Not supported by gpt-oss models.

fallbacks.description: An array of fallback objects. Each object must include a `model` and can optionally override any field from the original request. If the primary model fails, the LLM Gateway tries each fallback in order until one succeeds. See [Specify fallback models](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/llm-gateway/fallback) for more details.

fallback_config.description: Configuration for fallback behavior, including retry and depth settings. See [Specify fallback models](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/llm-gateway/fallback) for more details.

post_processing_steps.description: An ordered list of post-processing steps to apply to the model's response after generation. Currently supports `json-repair`, which automatically fixes malformed JSON in LLM Gateway content responses. See [Post-processing](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/llm-gateway/structured-outputs#post-processing) for details.

content.description: The content of the message. Can be a string or an array of content parts (for user messages).

name.description: An optional name for the participant.

content.description: The result of the tool call.

tool_call_id.description: The ID of the tool call that this message is responding to.

ContentPart.description: Currently only supports text content parts.

name.description: The name of the function to be called.

description.description: A description of what the function does.

parameters.description: A JSON Schema object describing the parameters the function accepts.

ToolChoice.description: Controls which (if any) function is called by the model.

ResponseFormat.description: Specifies the format of the model's response. Use `json_schema` type to constrain the model to output valid JSON matching a schema.

type.description: The type of response format. Use `json_schema` for structured outputs.

JsonSchemaConfig.description: Configuration for JSON schema-based structured outputs.

name.description: A name for the schema. Used for identification purposes.

schema.description: A valid JSON Schema object that defines the structure of the expected response.

strict.description: When `true`, the model will strictly adhere to the schema. Recommended for reliable parsing.

FallbackObject.description: A fallback model configuration. Each object must include a `model` and can optionally override any field from the original request. Fields not specified in the fallback inherit the values from the original request. See [Specify fallback models](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/llm-gateway/fallback) for more details.

model.description: The fallback model to use. See [LLM Gateway Overview](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/llm-gateway/quickstart#available-models) for available models.

messages.description: Override the messages for the fallback request.

max_tokens.description: Override the maximum number of tokens to generate in the fallback completion.

temperature.description: Override the temperature for the fallback request.

FallbackConfig.description: Configuration for fallback behavior. See [Specify fallback models](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/llm-gateway/fallback) for more details.

retry.description: Whether to automatically retry the request once after 500ms on failure. Defaults to `true`.

depth.description: The maximum number of fallbacks to traverse. Defaults to `1`, with a maximum of `2`.

PostProcessingStep.description: A single post-processing operation to apply to the model's response.

type.description: The type of post-processing to apply. Currently `json-repair` is supported.

request.description: A copy of the original request, excluding `prompt` and `messages`.

http_status_code.description: The HTTP status code of the response

llm_status_code.description: The status code from the LLM provider

finish_reason.description: The reason the model stopped generating tokens.

content.description: The text content of the model's response. Null or empty when the model is only emitting tool_calls.

arguments.description: The arguments to call the function with, as a JSON-formatted string.

transcript_id.description: The ID of the transcript to process.

speech_understanding.description: The speech understanding task to perform. Supports [Translation](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/speech-understanding/translation), [Speaker Identification](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/speech-understanding/speaker-identification), and [Custom Formatting](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/speech-understanding/custom-formatting). Click into the request object below to see the available options.

target_languages.description: List of target language codes (e.g., `["es", "de"]`). See [Translation](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/speech-understanding/translation) for supported languages.

formal.description: Use formal language style. See [Translation](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/speech-understanding/translation) for more details.

match_original_utterance.description: When enabled with Speaker Labels, returns translated text in the utterances array. Each utterance will include a `translated_texts` key containing translations for each target language.

speaker_type.description: Type of speaker identification. See [Speaker Identification](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/speech-understanding/speaker-identification) for details on each type.

known_values.description: Required if speaker_type is "role". Each value must be 35 characters or less.

speakers.description: An array of speaker objects with metadata to improve identification accuracy. Each object should include a `role` or `name` (depending on `speaker_type`) and an optional `description` to help the model identify the speaker. You can also include any additional custom properties (e.g., `company`, `title`) to provide more context. Use this as an alternative to `known_values` when you want to provide additional context about each speaker.

role.description: The role of the speaker. Required when `speaker_type` is "role".

name.description: The name of the speaker. Required when `speaker_type` is "name".

description.description: A description of the speaker to help the model identify them based on conversational context.

date.description: Date format pattern (e.g., `"mm/dd/yyyy"`). See [Custom Formatting](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/speech-understanding/custom-formatting) for more details.

phone_number.description: Phone number format pattern (e.g., `"(xxx)xxx-xxxx"`). See [Custom Formatting](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/speech-understanding/custom-formatting) for more details.

email.description: Email format pattern (e.g., `"username@domain.com"`). See [Custom Formatting](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/speech-understanding/custom-formatting) for more details.

summary_type.description: Type of summary. Bullets returns short bullet point style summaries, paragraph is generally more verbose and detailed.

include_decisions.description: Option to include decision making in action items.

translated_texts.description: Translated text keyed by language code (e.g., `{"es": "Texto traducido"}`)

utterances.description: Array of utterances with translations (when `match_original_utterance` is true)

translated_texts.description: Translations keyed by language code (e.g., `{"es": "Texto traducido", "de": "Übersetzter Text"}`). Only present when `match_original_utterance` is enabled.

mapping.description: A mapping of the original generic speaker labels (e.g., "A", "B") to the identified speaker names or roles.

formatted_utterances.description: Array of formatted utterances. Only included when utterances exist and formatting was applied.

ListAvailableModelsResponse.description: The response returned by the models endpoint.

data.description: The list of models available through LLM Gateway.

ModelDetails.description: Details about a model available through LLM Gateway.

id.description: The model ID. Use this value in the `model` field of a chat completion request.

name.description: The human-readable name of the model.

context_length.description: The maximum context length of the model, in tokens.

supported_parameters.description: The request parameters and features supported by the model (e.g., `max_tokens`, `temperature`, `tools`, `tool_choice`, `response_format`, `stream`).

default_parameters.description: Default parameter values applied to requests for this model. A `null` value means no default is set.

top_provider.description: Information about the best provider for this model. Not yet supported.

pricing.description: Pricing details for the model, in USD per 1 million tokens.

retirement_date.description: The Unix timestamp of the model's retirement date. `0` if no retirement date is set.

available_regions.description: The regions where the model is available (`us`, `eu`, and/or `global`). See [Cloud endpoints & data residency](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/llm-gateway/cloud-endpoints-and-data-residency) for more details.

DefaultParameters.description: Default parameter values applied to requests for this model. A `null` value means no default is set.

temperature.description: The default temperature for this model, if any.

top_p.description: The default top_p for this model, if any.

frequency_penalty.description: The default frequency penalty for this model, if any.

TopProvider.description: Information about the best provider for this model. Not yet supported.

context_length.description: The maximum context length supported by the provider, in tokens.

max_completion_tokens.description: The maximum number of completion tokens supported by the provider.

ModelPricing.description: Pricing details for the model, in USD per 1 million tokens.

global.description: Pricing for global processing. See [Global routing](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/llm-gateway/cloud-endpoints-and-data-residency#global-routing) for more details.

us.description: US-specific pricing. Only present when the model has pricing distinct from global pricing in the US region.

eu.description: EU-specific pricing. Only present when the model has pricing distinct from global pricing in the EU region.

regional_increase_percent.description: The fractional price increase applied to in-region (US or EU) processing relative to global pricing (e.g., `0.1` means 10%).

ModelPricingData.description: Prices in USD per 1 million tokens.

prompt.description: The price per 1 million input (prompt) tokens.

completions.description: The price per 1 million output (completion) tokens.

input_cache_read.description: The price per 1 million cached input tokens read. Only present for models that support prompt caching.

input_cache_write.description: The price per 1 million input tokens written to the cache. Only present for models that support prompt caching.

input_cache_write_1h.description: The price per 1 million input tokens written to the cache with a 1-hour TTL. Only present for models that support prompt caching.

code.description: HTTP status code for the error.

message.description: A human-readable description of the error.

metadata.description: Optional. Present on 400 responses with per-field validation details.

errors.description: List of specific validation failure messages.

x-qore-normalized.reason: The action-items response declares items and status, but its required list incorrectly names action_items instead of items. https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/llm-gateway/api-reference/create-speech-understanding
The vendor uses bool for boolean schema properties. OpenAPI requires the boolean type name; values and field contracts are unchanged.
